sentences.en: The teacher asked us to list all the prime numbers between one and fifty.
sentences.zh: 老师要求我们列出一到五十之间的所有质数。

sentences.en: Understanding prime numbers is crucial for cracking some types of encryption codes.
sentences.zh: 理解质数对于破解某些类型的加密代码至关重要。

sentences.en: My math project involves finding the largest known prime number in history.
sentences.zh: 我的数学项目是找出历史上已知的最大质数。
